connector.name: ABAP Accelerator
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for SAP ABAP development with 15 tools for ABAP objects, syntax, ATC, and more
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package abap-accelerator. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the openkash account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
